concrete_turn_boundary: Finish the acting player eighth own turn, including cleanup questions; stop at its actual TurnChangedEvent. Do not cap merely because turn eight started or use global-turn arithmetic.
counting: Every submitted GameAction from either player, including pass, mulligan and other decision response; rejected and throwing attempts count. Initialization and internal events do not count.
precedence: Rejected action, exception or unresolved telemetry invalidate the attempt. Consistent real engine terminal/draw beats caps; action cap takes display precedence over simultaneous turn cap while both flags remain.
scope: Bounded execute-once submission wrapper and public engine status extraction.
Preserve real winner/end reason only as engine diagnostics; never manufacture a capped winner.
Refuse any submission after a cap, fault or terminal status; no fallback, retry or stack/decision draining.
Public turn counters must agree with matching ordered TurnChangedEvents; terminal state must match GameEndedEvent.
Serialize status diagnostics including both cap flags, actual counts and residual stack depth/pending-question flag.
